source.file: Archives of the Empire - Vol I.pdf

summary: Weapons, ammunition, Skill choices & Youngblood · no unnamed profiles

included: Four previously reviewed ammunition entries and descriptions (pp. 93–94).
Printed Skill specialisations from the existing pack, using core grouped Skill definitions.
Youngblood (p. 78), using the existing approved maximum-one adaptation and contextual Eonir Status effect.
excluded: All 13 stat blocks are named NPCs; no unnamed creature profiles or templates were found.
Badger Rider (p. 91) names tamed badgers and barding but gives no badger statistics; no animal foundation is invented.
Career development, PC origin/clan creation allocations, followers, hirelings and campaign activity remain outside the GM creator scope.
decisions: Reuse approved PC equipment and Talent data; do not duplicate profiles or change core equipment.
Precision Shot and Powder uses Archives I's price alone and the approved Up in Arms price when both are enabled.
Only actual adaptations receive Legacy; unchanged equipment is not tagged merely for being Fourth Edition.
